purpose: Execute the atomic copy-body operation within the MA-13 boundary: Geometry-copy variant only. It accepts a current DesignBody or transient source, returns a transient copy, and does not translate, rotate, attach, name, or target a component.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires copy-body and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A closed nonempty source body; its shape is copied and the source is not attached by this action.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance used to compare source and copied volumes.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: An independent transient geometry copy; attachment remains MA-12.

postconditions: shape_of(source).Copy() has independent identity from the source.
Copied volume matches source within volume_tolerance_mm3.
The copy passes require_transient and assert_closed.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic copy-body operation within the MA-13 boundary: Geometry-copy variant only. It accepts a current DesignBody or transient source, returns a transient copy, and does not translate, rotate, attach, name, or target a component. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: No document selection is performed inside this action; supplied references are validated directly.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable to transient source/copy geometry.

failure_modes.condition: Source is not a closed nonempty body or Copy raises.
failure_modes.detection: Source is not a closed nonempty body or Copy raises.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

failure_modes.condition: Copy identity, volume, or transient checks fail.
failure_modes.detection: Copy identity, volume, or transient checks fail.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use and retain only a clean run-owned state.

recovery.action: Discard any partial transient copy and supply a valid source.
Discard the copied body and rerun from the unchanged source; no attachment rollback is needed.
